title: LAVA Genie: AI-Integrated Stringless Smart Guitar
summary: A modular, stringless digital instrument that combines a touch-sensitive interface with AI-powered music composition tools. It allows users to decode, transcribe, and perform songs using simplified chord modes and real-time AI backing tracks.
research_notes: Features a unique foldable design and built-in 32W subwoofer system; advanced AI features require a LAVA+ subscription.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from smart acoustic guitars to a fully digital, stringless platform with the Genie launch in late 2024. The ecosystem now centers on the LAVA+ app's AI song decoding capabilities and modular hardware expansion.
